text.tspan: Mean income per day within the poorest decile (before tax), 1970 to 2024
The mean income per day within the poorest decile (tenth of the population). This data is adjusted for inflation
and differences in living costs between countries. Income here is measured before taxes and benefits. Income

has been
equivalized
– adjusted to account for the fact that people in the same household can share costs like
rent and heating.
